sbic_identity.resolution: Three separate Japanese regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies: Tokyo (SBIC East Japan), Nagoya (SBIC Central Japan), and Osaka (SBIC West Japan). Official company profiles identify them as sister companies and public policy investment-development institutions established under Japan's Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Companies Act. They are not SBI Holdings subsidiaries or divisions.

sbic_chatgpt_phrase.closest_primary_context: Tokyo SBIC's official 2025-02-26 seminar titled '生成AI（チャットGPT）の現在と未来' (The Present and Future of Generative AI/ChatGPT), co-hosted with the Taito branch of the Tokyo Chamber of Commerce and Industry. The listed speaker was a Microsoft Japan executive/evangelist.
sbic_chatgpt_phrase.interpretation: A ChatGPT-related seminar hosted by the Tokyo SBIC regional investment-development company is not evidence of an OpenAI partnership or a relationship with SBI Holdings.

ask_coin.current_official_token_standard: LayerZero OFT; official Permission documentation lists Base and Polygon as active networks.
ask_coin.issuer_buyback_claim: Permission's tokenomics documentation says a portion of subscription revenue from family-focused products is used to buy ASK on the open market and fund ecosystem rewards. This is an issuer statement, not independently verified execution or realized buyback volume.
ask_coin.historical_contract_discrepancy: Permission's January 2025 Base launch release listed 0x79322cee6c90735b967d2396b9adc392915aebb6. Current official docs list a different Base OFT contract and the Polygon contract. CoinGecko says the older Wormhole-bridged Base ASK must be repatriated through Polygon before bridging back via LayerZero. Treat the 2025 address as historical pending chain-level verification; do not merge balances across contracts.

actual_capital.control_rule: Do not equate announced financing capacity, effective registration, in-kind XRP, gross proceeds, exercised warrants, or committed facilities with cash actually received. Reconcile issuer filings, settlement dates, bank/custody evidence where public, and use-of-proceeds disclosures separately.

ripple_coinbase_rlusd.availability_at_2026_10_28: Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase retail; RLUSD deposits/withdrawals on XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
ripple_coinbase_rlusd.caveat: Ripple's October 28 Coinbase announcement said Global Exchange collateral support would follow; it did not say RLUSD collateral was live at launch. This is not proof of XRP collateral or spot XRP buying.
